name: browse
description: Adds /browse: a web browser in a pane beside Claude Code.

renderer.title: How the page is drawn
renderer.description: auto draws real pixels in kitty and Ghostty and colored blocks everywhere else, so most people never touch this. Forcing real pixels in a terminal that cannot draw them leaves the pane saying so.
options: always real pixels (kitty or Ghostty only)

chrome.title: Browser to draw in (blank: find one)
chrome.description: browse drives a real browser. Blank looks for Chrome, Chromium, Brave or Edge in Applications and on your PATH. Only paste a full path here if the pane says it cannot find one, e.g. /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome.

node.title: Node.js 18+ to run it (blank: node)
node.description: Node runs the small helper that talks to the browser. Only set this if node is not on your PATH or you want a specific version; a name on PATH or a full path.
